searches.query: how to use breakpoint values in custom CSS media queries with theme variables
Tailwind v4 exposes breakpoints as theme variables like --breakpoint-md, which you can use in custom CSS with @media (width >= theme(--breakpoint-xl)) or the max-* and min-* variants.
